//: The issue/PR labels every package repo should carry, snapshotted from tselect-npm/url. `dependencies` is the load-bearing one: .github/dependabot.yml applies it by name, and a Dependabot PR into a repo without it opens unlabelled. The rest are GitHub's defaults, kept so the seven repos read the same.
//prune: When false (the default) `sync` only creates and updates; labels present on a repo but absent here are reported and left alone. Deleting a label detaches it from every issue that used it, which is not something to do as a side effect of a settings sync.
//description: A null description means the field is unmanaged, not that it must be blank. `url` predates GitHub's descriptions on the default labels; the repos created later have them. Enforcing null would delete real text from six repos to match an absence in one. Write a string here to take ownership of a description.

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file
